_note: The two parked V1 rows (embassies, foreign aid), landed on the existing effects.relations channel as the V3 tier's call. Magnitudes anchored on the measured ladder, not tuned: an embassy is state_visit's goodwill class (+5 relations, 12-month cooldown) bought once -- +6 at a 240-month cooldown, gated on having met at all, so it cannot substitute for the visit and cannot be repeated; foreign aid is settle_dispute's climbdown class priced at home (+8 relations, six-bloc split, every bloc under MAX_ACTION_BLOC_OFFSET's 0.15 ceiling), cooldown 48, because giving money away should be seen to cost something at home. The domestic prices are per-bloc by design -- a price on fewer than six blocs never clears the +-3.0 poll-noise floor in the roll-up (diplomacy-model's split-price property), and aid IS a split question: the spending-minded blocs approve, the ones who wanted it spent here do not.

actions.name: Open an Embassy
actions.summary: A permanent resident mission in the partner's capital. It costs little and says much: the relationship is now infrastructure, not correspondence.

actions.name: Foreign Aid Package
actions.summary: Budget support for a partner under strain. Gratitude abroad; at home, every bloc that would rather have spent it here says so.
